repos.name: HireKitApp
repos.stack_note: monorepo with two stacks: backend/ is python-api and web/ is react-web (ADR-0007); the kit plans one stack per entry, so each folder is adopted with onboard-repo --stack rather than new-repo
repos.tech: Python 3.14, FastAPI, async SQLAlchemy, Alembic, PostgreSQL (backend/); React, TypeScript, Vite (web/)
repos.responsibility: The API, the background worker and the web app in one repository, each folder with its own gate, plus the shared docs, seed data and recordings

apps.name: Api and worker
apps.for: the REST API, the job worker, the anonymizer, the scoring pipeline and the model gateway

apps.name: Web
apps.for: recruiters and interviewers using the ranked list, detail, kit, feedback and comparison screens
